title: The Dramatized Newsroom
pitch: Pull a real unfolding event's exact positions and timeline from God's Eye View (a ship adrift, a flight diverting, a wildfire's spread) and feed those coordinates and timestamps into ArtCraft to stage a cinematic, camera-directed dramatization of the event: real-world accuracy from the live data, filmmaker-grade visual polish from the crafting engine. News outlets and explainer YouTubers who currently choose between dry stock-footage B-roll and expensive dramatic reenactments buy this as a fast middle path: accurate, watchable video built within hours of a breaking event, not days.
why_now: Both repos trended the same day and solve opposite halves of the same problem: one has the real, live ground truth but a utilitarian simulator look; the other can stage anything beautifully but has no connection to real-world data on its own. Wiring the globe's live feed into ArtCraft's scene tools turns raw open data into a publishable visual in the same news cycle.
